title: Nvidia Spends Record $2.2 Million to Fight AI Chip Export Rules

tickers.name: Alphabet Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The chipmaker's government relations budget hit a new peak as it lobbied federal officials throughout the third quarter. Nvidia spent nearly $2.2 million on federal lobbying during that period, federal filings show, marking the highest amount the company has ever spent in a single quarter.

This spending surge occurred as Nvidia, Intel, Google, and Anthropic engaged in widespread lobbying to oppose proposals that would restrict the export of AI chips. These firms focused their efforts during the third quarter to prevent the imposition of those trade limitations.
